offering_description.value: Provides healthcare workforce staffing and technology solutions to hospitals, health systems and government facilities. It places travel, per diem and permanent nurses, allied health professionals and physicians, and sells workforce management software. It earns fees for staffing services and recurring software subscriptions.

primary_services.value: nurse staffing; allied health staffing; locum tenens physician staffing; physician and leadership search; workforce management consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, health systems, physician groups, post-acute care providers; B2G: federal and government-run healthcare facilities

end_markets.value: healthcare providers; hospitals and health systems; post-acute care; government healthcare

revenue_model.value: service fees: hourly or per-placement fees for placed clinical and physician staff; subscription: recurring fees for workforce management and scheduling software

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in clinical professionals and sells their staffing to healthcare facilities; software / platform: takes in facility staffing needs and sells vendor management and scheduling software

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide across US states, serving hospitals and facilities in all regions

specialization.value: related lines: nurse and allied staffing, physician locum tenens and search, workforce technology, all sold to healthcare providers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: dedicated account teams selling contracts directly to hospitals and health systems

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state staffing agency licensing and healthcare workforce rules, plus HIPAA data privacy requirements
